restrictions: Two-block ordinary collision attack of Guo, Liao, Liu, Liu, Qiao and Song (Journal of Cryptology 2020) on 5-round SHA3-256, with real collisions published: 2-round connector (428.8 core-hours, converted conservatively) plus 2^36.70 pairs in the brute-force stage.
Success probability 0.6 at the stated expected work.

heuristics.statement: The 3-round trail core No. 3 of the source holds with probability 2^-36.70 over the connector's affine message space, and the 2-round connector is solved within the reported 428.8 core-hours.
heuristics.scope: The cited attack of Journal of Cryptology 2020 (Guo, Liao, Liu, Liu, Qiao, Song), applied to this exact target (standard IV, full message, all digest bits).
heuristics.extrapolation: The source reports real 5-round SHA3-256 collisions (Table 17) found within the stated Tc and Tb.
heuristics.limitations: The probability estimates are the source's (standard independence assumptions); this package re-prices but does not re-derive them.
